# CareID Enterprise Backend — Staging Integration Collection

Official API collection for the **CareID / Health Vault 360** clinical, identity, and governance platform backend, representing the verified **November 3, 2026 Staging Release**.

## Deployment Context
- **Target Staging API:** `https://360api.vnvision.in`
- **Default Base URL:** `https://360api.vnvision.in/api/v1`
- **Database Engine:** PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM (144 clinical & administrative tables)
- **Process Manager:** Native Linux startup script on host (`161.97.89.183`, port `3073`)
- **Total Operations:** 510 HTTP operations across 27 domain folders
- **Zero Database Migrations:** Strictly migration-free release

## Automated URL Normalization
The collection includes a pre-request script that automatically normalizes `{{baseUrl}}`. Whether your Postman environment has `baseUrl` set to `https://360api.vnvision.in/api/v1` or `https://360api.vnvision.in`, requests will resolve cleanly without duplicate `/api/v1` path segments.
